snippet.title: Her Dark Ages
snippet.description:
Her Dark Ages takes you into the shadows of history, where women's stories were never meant to be told. ⚔️
Before modern medicine, before rights, before freedom — women were born into a world of silence, struggle, and survival. From the cold stone floors of medieval castles 🏰 to the smoke-filled huts of peasant villages, their daily lives were harder than most history books dare to admit.
Childbirth was a death sentence. Marriage was a transaction. Speaking too loudly could get you punished. 🕯️
Yet they endured. They raised empires, buried children, and kept the world running from the shadows.
This channel uncovers the raw, unfiltered truth of what it meant to be a woman across the ancient and medieval world. No glamour. No fairy tales. Just history as it actually was. ⚱️
Subscribe if you believe forgotten voices deserve to be heard.
#medievalwomendailylife
#ancientwomenhistory
#womeninthemiddleages
#medievalqueens 
#womeninhistory 
#historyofwomen 
#HerDarkAge

snippet.title: George's History
snippet.description:
History has always mattered to me for reasons beyond dates and turning points. What fascinates me is how the past once felt ordinary while it was happening—how people went about their lives without knowing their moment would one day be studied.

Today, I use AI as a visual instrument to help re-create those lost viewpoints. The aim isn’t spectacle or revisionism. It’s perspective. To step back into spaces as they once were and understand history from the inside, not from a textbook summary.

This channel focuses on visual reconstructions that emphasise atmosphere, place, and human scale. Streets, rooms, landscapes—rebuilt carefully to help the past feel less distant and more real.

No shortcuts. No hype.
Just a quieter way of seeing history.

snippet.title: History Time
snippet.description:
Travel back in time with me to some of the most fascinating moments in human history. Witness colossal sea battles involving tens of thousands of men, take part in pagan blood rituals in the mysterious forests of Northern Europe and engage in highly orchestrated tribal warfare within Pre-Columbian Mesoamerica. All this and more from the comfort of your own living room/bus to work/toilet throne.

Established in early 2017, History Time is researched, written, filmed, narrated & produced by Pete Kelly - public educator from the UK with history degrees at undergraduate and postgraduate level.

Guest writers include historians, authors and archaeologists such as Dr Raoul McLaughlin, Dr David Frye, Dr David Miano & Gordon Doherty.

Original music is composed for the channel by Joss Edwards, Brodie Marshall & Matt Hunt

No AI is used. 

Sign up to my free mailing list for adventures at the worlds greatest archaeological sites-
http://historytimewithpete.substack.com

snippet.title: The Infographics Show
snippet.description:
Facts are fun, but most are presented in boring and badly edited videos. The Infographics Show focuses on making animated motion infographic videos, made in a fun and entertaining way. 

Software that we use: Adobe Audition for voice recording, Adobe Illustrator for dealing with vectors, and Adobe After Effects for animation.

snippet.title: Made In History
snippet.description:
"History is ours. The people make history"

Welcome. If you're new to History, come join us as we go through the story of World History. 

ALL OUR VIDEOS ARE PLACED INTO PLAYLISTS SECTIONED ON HOMEPAGE!

CURRENT PROJECTS:
LVL1: History of the World (1/1) COMPLETE
LVL2: History by period mega-docs: 5-part overview series on the different time periods. 
(5/5 done!) COMPLETE
LVL3: History by subregion documentaries: 30-part series on all the subregions of the world!
(1/30 done NEXT: Central Africa)

I'm a History major and used to be a writer for Watchmojo before they ran out of ideas and decided to try making vids of my own. I've written scripts, breaking news, and sports, but my passion has always been history since it molds the present and it's important for us to acknowledge we do not live in a vacuum.

"Be ruthless with systems. Be kind to people"
